record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.context_brief: Valuations computing lct of graded ideals
record.original_question: Let x in (X = Spec(R), Delta) be a klt singularity, let a_• be an m_x-primary graded sequence of ideals, let c = lct(X, Delta; a_•), and let LCP(X, Delta + c a_•) be the valuations computing that log canonical threshold. Must every valuation in LCP(X, Delta + c a_•) be quasi-monomial? More strongly, does there exist a log smooth model (Y, E) -> X such that LCP(X, Delta + c a_•) is contained in QM(Y, E) and forms a cone over a connected convex set?

evidence.quote:
Problem 37. In the above notation,
(1) (Weaker version [JM12]) All valuations in LCP(X, ∆ + c · a•) are quasi-monomial.
(2) (Stronger version) There exists a log smooth model (Y, E) → X such that
LCP(X, ∆ + c · a•) ⊆ QM(Y, E)
is a cone over a connected convex set.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $(X = \mathrm{Spec}(R), \Delta)$ be a klt singularity at a closed point $x \in X$; here $R$ is a Noetherian local ring (or the local ring at $x$ of a normal variety) with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}_x$, and $\Delta$ is an effective $\mathbb{Q}$-divisor on $X$ such that $K_X + \Delta$ is $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier and $(X,\Delta)$ has Kawamata log terminal singularities.

Let $a_\bullet = \{a_m\}_{m \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 1}}$ be an $\mathfrak{m}_x$-primary graded sequence of ideals on $X$, i.e. each $a_m \subseteq R$ is $\mathfrak{m}_x$-primary and $a_p \cdot a_q \subseteq a_{p+q}$ for all $p,q \ge 1$. Define the log canonical threshold
$$ c \;=\; \mathrm{lct}(X,\Delta;\, a_\bullet) \;=\; \lim_{m\to\infty} m\cdot \mathrm{lct}(X,\Delta;\, a_m). $$

For a real valuation $v$ of the function field of $X$ centered at $x$, let $A_{X,\Delta}(v)$ denote its log discrepancy, and set $v(a_\bullet) = \lim_{m\to\infty} v(a_m)/m$. Define
$$ \mathrm{LCP}(X,\Delta + c\cdot a_\bullet) \;=\; \bigl\{\, v \;:\; A_{X,\Delta}(v) \,=\, c\cdot v(a_\bullet),\ \ 0 < A_{X,\Delta}(v) < \infty \,\bigr\}, $$
the set of (nontrivial) valuations computing this log canonical threshold.

A log smooth model $\pi:(Y,E) \to X$ is a proper birational morphism from a regular scheme $Y$ with a reduced simple normal crossing divisor $E = \sum_{i=1}^N E_i$ such that $\pi$ is an isomorphism over $X \setminus \{x\}$. For any point $\eta \in Y$ that is the generic point of a connected component of $\bigcap_{i \in I} E_i$ for some $I \subseteq \{1,\dots,N\}$, and any tuple $\alpha = (\alpha_i)_{i \in I} \in \mathbb{R}^I_{\ge 0}$, one obtains a quasi-monomial valuation $v_\alpha$ of $K(X)$ via the regular system of parameters defining $E$ at $\eta$. Let $\mathrm{QM}(Y,E)$ be the set of all such quasi-monomial valuations.

Questions.
(1) Is every valuation $v \in \mathrm{LCP}(X,\Delta + c\cdot a_\bullet)$ quasi-monomial?
(2) (Stronger form) Does there exist a log smooth model $(Y,E) \to X$ such that
$$ \mathrm{LCP}(X,\Delta + c\cdot a_\bullet) \;\subseteq\; \mathrm{QM}(Y,E), $$
and such that, viewed inside $\mathrm{QM}(Y,E)$, the set $\mathrm{LCP}(X,\Delta + c\cdot a_\bullet)$ is a cone over a connected convex set?
artifact.category_tag: K-stability and valuations on klt singularities
artifact.status_search_result: The weaker form of the Jonsson–Mustaţă conjecture is known to hold in dimension two and reduces in general to the case of graded sequences of valuation ideals on affine space. Existence of some quasi-monomial valuation computing the lct of a graded sequence is established (Jonsson–Mustaţă), and Xu's theorem "A minimizing valuation is quasi-monomial" (Ann. of Math. 2020) settles a closely related minimizing problem. However, the full statement that every valuation in LCP$(X,\Delta + c\cdot a_\bullet)$ is quasi-monomial, and the stronger cone/convexity statement, remain open in general.

status_evidence.title: Valuations and asymptotic invariants for sequences of ideals (Jonsson–Mustaţă)
status_evidence.snippet: Conjectures that valuations computing asymptotic jumping numbers are quasi-monomial; proven in dimension two and reduced to affine space.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture that valuations computing lct of graded sequences of ideals are quasi-monomial is the Jonsson–Mustaţă conjecture, known in dim 2, open in general.

status_evidence.title: A Minimizing Valuation is Quasi-monomial (Xu)
status_evidence.snippet: Proves that any valuation minimizing the normalized volume on a klt singularity is quasi-monomial.
status_evidence.claim: A related minimizing-valuation problem on klt singularities is solved, but the lct-computing version remains open.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic Zhou valuations
status_evidence.snippet: States that an algebraic version of the Jonsson–Mustaţă conjecture is equivalent to all Zhou valuations being quasi-monomial.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work treats the conjecture as still open and explores equivalent formulations.
